name: Connection — dynamic deployment listing
summary: Connections that declare a `modelDiscovery` endpoint and rely on runtime GET /models calls to enumerate deployments are not honored — only the static `models[]` array works today.
description: Per the official docs, ModelGateway connections support both static and dynamic discovery. In practice only the static path (models pre-listed in connection metadata) is wired up; the dynamic path that calls the gateway's list-deployments endpoint at runtime to enumerate available models is not currently honored. Agents created against a model that exists only via dynamic discovery fail validation.
notes: Status-only. Static discovery (`routing-static-vs-dynamic-discovery`) is the working configuration today.
